# Start here

Use this route for your own **quantitative-trait beta summary statistics**. This scaffold supports autosomal biallelic SNVs; other effect types and variant classes require a deliberate extension.

Start by writing the trait, comparison, population, effect units, genome build and question. Summary-statistics inspection cannot substitute for upstream sample/genotype QC or a fitted association model.
